```text
# PR #3585: Patch: shard the slow server api CI job into 4

Closes #3580

## What changed and why

`rust (test server api)` ran 7m 24s in CI run 42716908774, tripping the 7-minute alert (#73). The fix is the bot-alone tool from #3072: a shard count in [scripts/ci-shards.toml](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-3580/scripts/ci-shards.toml). `"server api"` goes from 1 to 4, with a comment in the file's existing style naming the 7m 24s and #3580. Each of the four jobs runs the ~300 tests whose names hash to it (CRC-32 of the test name, so no test is skipped), which should land every shard under the 5-minute target with headroom. One file modified, nothing else.

## How I tested it

- `python3 .github/ci/matrix.py matrix` — exit 0; stderr lists exactly `rust (test server api 1/4)` through `rust (test server api 4/4)`, no other new job. Each shard keeps the group's unchanged test filter, scope `server`, and cache `server`; the group declares no doc tests or binaries check, so the shards correctly carry none.
- `cd bot && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` — 54 tests, 52 pass. The 2 failures are both pin tests that hold the committed counts to 1, i.e. the known person follow-up (see below), not defects: `test_the_committed_files_give_todays_jobs` (JOBS list and `{(1, 1)}` assertion) and `test_a_count_splits_a_group_into_that_many_jobs` (line 108, `22 != 19`).
- `git status --porcelain` — only `M scripts/ci-shards.toml`. No Rust, catalog, patch, ruling, web, or e2e file changed, so no cargo test, fmt, or spec check applies; the harness re-runs its checks after.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- Kept the plan's count of 4 (rejected: 2 with no headroom, 8 with almost no gain since compile repeats per shard, and a new group first since that needs `.github/`, which the bot may not change).
- Departure from the plan: it predicted exactly one pin-test failure, but there are two. The second, `test_a_count_splits_a_group_into_that_many_jobs` (line 108), copies the committed counts into a temp repo, so it inherits the `= 4` and its `len(JOBS) + 1 + 2` assertion fails. I recommend the person fix it robustly (capture the pre-edit job count as baseline and assert `before + 1 + 2`) rather than hardcoding `+ 3`, so the next count change does not break it again. I did not touch `bot/` myself: the harness reverts such changes.

## For a person before merge (cannot be done by the bot)

1. Required: in [bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-2/_work/_temp/work/item-3580/bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py), apply the plan's Open-questions pin update (JOBS gains `server api 1/4`–`4/4`; the shards assertion gains `(1, 4)`–`(4, 4)`) **plus** the line-108 fix above. `bot selftest` stays red until then; the pull request must not merge before it.
2. Conditional: if this pull request's CI still shows any `server api k/4` shard at or over 5 minutes, split the group in `.github/ci/rust-test.toml` (lines 117–121) into lib-only and integration-only groups per the plan's Open-questions TOML.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 2.1 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 18s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 1162s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 5s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 11s |

</details>
